explain.en: Draw Things models folder. It also holds your saved configurations, imported model lists and LoRA training files, so Hoardless only shows the size. Remove models inside Draw Things.
explain.zh: Draw Things 的模型文件夹。里面还有你保存的配置、导入模型清单和 LoRA 训练文件，所以这里只显示大小。要删请在 Draw Things 里操作。

notes: Sandbox container paths: reading them can trigger a macOS privacy prompt. The GUI External Folder setting is stored inside the sandbox; needs a resolver. DRAWTHINGS_MODELS_DIR only affects draw-things-cli, not the app. Container not probed on the maintainer's Mac.
